scope_note: Statuses describe the original canonical HCA root causes. Fresh-challenge variants are listed explicitly and prevent campaign closeout where applicable.

root_causes.name: DIRECT_LOOKUP_HIJACK
root_causes.invariant: A direct reference requires numeric structure; ordinary natural language cannot enter lookup by a short alphabetic prefix.

root_causes.name: NORMALIZATION_ERASES_INTENT
root_causes.invariant: INV-NORMALIZATION-PRESERVES-INTENT: normalization cannot turn contradictory money ranges plausible or close an explicitly open time span.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: FRESH-MONEY-003/005 expose a distinct lower-bound loss for small-money ranges.

root_causes.name: DIMENSIONAL_NEGATION
root_causes.invariant: Negation binds to its dimension before positive extractors; unsupported dimensions clarify without positive leakage or source execution.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: FRESH-NEGATION-005 is a P0 negative-state conjugation fail-open.

root_causes.name: TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS
root_causes.invariant: Specific span wins; exact day/month/year, explicit and open ranges, relatives, invalid dates, and reversed ranges preserve their declared semantics.

root_causes.name: CONTROL_LANGUAGE_TO_TOPIC
root_causes.invariant: Control language changes ordering or question mode and is not content; ordering-only follow-ups preserve WHERE.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: Polite pagination, natural reset, and licitar variants remain open P1 findings.

root_causes.name: ACTOR_ROUTING_HYGIENE
root_causes.invariant: EXACT > USER_SELECTION > FUZZY_CANDIDATES; casing is not evidence, fuzzy never authorizes identity, and an explicit new search beats pending state.

root_causes.name: MONEY_ADMISSION
root_causes.invariant: Explicit money evidence is not dropped by magnitude; unsupported compound amounts clarify instead of executing a partial amount.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: Small-money range lower bounds are silently lost in FRESH-MONEY-003/005.

root_causes.name: STATE_PROJECTION
root_causes.invariant: Exact states do not widen and declared families project completely and consistently to the selected dataset.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: FRESH-STATE-002 declares oferta_abierta while querying Cerrado/Seleccionado.

root_causes.name: GENERIC_BUYER_AS_TOPIC
root_causes.invariant: An unqualified generic buyer clarifies and never becomes a content keyword or arbitrary entity scope.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: Buyer purchase-verb queries route to procesos and leak the verb as topic in FRESH-BUYER-002/CROSS-004.

root_causes.name: DERIVED_EXECUTION_STATE_PERSISTENCE
root_causes.invariant: Derived execution-only entity ecosystems do not persist into conversational state; ordering changes ORDER BY without changing WHERE.
root_causes.fresh_boundary: Covered ordering variants pass; separate pagination/reset variants remain open.
